Family Sues US Government Over Fatal ICE Shooting

The family of Renee Good has filed a wrongful death lawsuit following her fatal shooting by a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent. The lawsuit names the U.S. government, an ICE officer, and Trump administration officials as defendants. The family alleges the shooting was unjustified and is seeking damages.
